# sherpa-list

A vertical row container. Slot [sherpa-list-item](sherpa-list-item.md) children, or call populate() to stamp rows from the .row-tpl prototype.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Figma | List |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-list/sherpa-list.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-list/sherpa-list.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-list/sherpa-list.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-list/sherpa-list.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-list/sherpa-list.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-list><sherpa-list-item data-label="Increase contrast" data-description="Stronger borders and text."><sherpa-switch slot="trailing" name="contrast" aria-label="Increase contrast"></sherpa-switch></sherpa-list-item><sherpa-list-item data-label="Reduce motion"></sherpa-list-item></sherpa-list>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-empty` | text |  | empty-state message No events of its own — child rows emit item-click, which the list uses to keep a single current row. |
| `data-type` | `plain` |  | (default — dividers between rows) \| plain (no dividers) |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| (default) | item |  |
